note: Durable version manifest. One entry per component, updated by hand at release time (same discipline as VERSION and CHANGELOG.md) so 'which version had the working Word Search generator' never requires searching old conversations.

word_search_engine.notes: The customer-facing Word Search route (services/product.py) has never used the shared topic engine — not in any release. It calls OpenAI directly and falls back to a hard-coded placeholder word list on failure. No version of the customer route is 'last known good'. Fix targeted for 1.7.2 (not yet released).

crossword_engine.notes: Customer-facing Crossword route has used the shared topic engine, local-only and fail-closed, since e81298e (2026-09-09). Unchanged since.

topic_vocabulary_resolver.notes: services/factory/topic_vocabulary.py + data/topic_vocabulary_packs.json. Byte-identical from e81298e through the current commit. Backs both Crossword and Spelling Worksheet; Word Search's customer route does not call it yet (see word_search_engine above).
